name: docyrus-open-ide

scripts.precheck: npm run patch:native-sdk && npm run bundle:tree
scripts.predev: npm run patch:native-sdk && npm run bundle:tree
scripts.prebuild: npm run patch:native-sdk && npm run bundle:tree
